# HelpGetUp

> HelpGetUp (helpgetup.com) is an early-stage, free guide for people stuck on food in Albany County, New York. It gives one clear next step: a sourced pantry, community meal, or produce stop open this week, or the official SNAP / EBT path (NYS myBenefits and the Albany County SNAP hotline). The person decides whether to take the step.

## What the site does
- Food walk: pick "Hungry tonight", "SNAP / EBT", or "Both"; enter an Albany County ZIP or neighborhood; see stops with published hours this week, closest first.
- Every stop names its source (the Food Pantries for the Capital District's Food Connect map and the February 2026 Albany County resource flyer) and the date the source was updated.
- Each stop offers "Open in Maps" and "Add to calendar", built only from the stop's published address and hours.

## What it does not do
- It does not call, email, fax, or send anything on a person's behalf, and it does not fill out government forms.
- It does not collect a Social Security number, driver's license, benefits password, or ID photo. The ZIP or neighborhood typed in stays in the browser.
- It is not an emergency service. In immediate danger, call 911.

## Scope
- Albany County, NY only. Food only (for now).
- Hours change; people should confirm by phone or with the Food Pantries referral line before going.

## Pages
- [Home and food walk](https://helpgetup.com/)

## Official sources it points to
- [NYS myBenefits](https://mybenefits.ny.gov/)
- [Food Connect map](https://map.thefoodpantries.org/)
